title: Selling Plans — Performance Standing Relief on Early Termination Fees
content:
The early termination fee of a **Selling Plans** store is relieved for a seller in good standing. The relief reads the seller's Seller Performance Standing record: the current performance level and the active violation points.

**Clause.** The standing relief of an early termination fee is the top termination standing relief when the seller's performance level is one of the discount standing levels and the standing record shows no active violation points, the above termination standing relief when the level is Above Standard Level and no active violation points are shown, and nothing otherwise.

The discount standing levels are Top Rated Level and Preferred Partner Level.

A relief is taken from the plan's early termination fee share: the reliefs that apply are added together first and the total is taken from the share once.

## Truth table

| Performance level | Active violation points | Standing relief taken from the share |
|---|---|---|
| Top Rated Level or Preferred Partner Level | Zero | 10 percentage points |
| Above Standard Level | Zero | 5 percentage points |
| Top Rated, Preferred Partner or Above Standard Level | One or more | None |
| Standard Level, Developing Seller Level or Below Standard Level | Any | None |

## Hypothetical cases

- Preferred Partner Level, 0 active points, share 75% → share of 65% after this relief alone.
- Above Standard Level, 0 active points, share 50% → 45%.
- Top Rated Level with 3 active violation points → no standing relief.
